requirements.requirement: Canonical nodes, aliases, pip identity/direction/attributes and independent oracle validation
requirements.remaining: Only 14 physically evidenced site instances; clock semantics and broader resource ownership/configuration remain incomplete.

requirements.requirement: Independent traversal-based training and new held-out data
requirements.remaining: Existing bounded capture/holdout evidence cannot establish full-device or all-family coverage.

requirements.requirement: Executable binary CSR/templates with full capacity accounting and strict equivalence
requirements.remaining: Graph image compression is separate from diagnostic trace encoding; platform transfer/capacity still unmeasured.

requirements.requirement: Same native search, initialization/first/resident/end-to-end timings, cache/granularity ablations
requirements.remaining: Seven repeats per condition completed, but shared-host/cache and partial site-model limitations remain.

requirements.requirement: Placed real design queries, resource occupancy/protection, complete router and quality validation
requirements.remaining: Prior physical readback is scoped to partial model; complete special-resource semantics and external IO remain.

requirements.requirement: Matching FPGA CSR/compact implementation, self-checking simulation, synthesis and routed timing/resources
requirements.remaining: Site occupancy52, retained nodes37 and retained edges37 full-depth synthetic RTL transactions are independently verified. Route tree stopped at7/50 without terminal receipt and remains unaccepted. Native full44 and its dependent chain remain failed; paired encoded full44 RTL, full30 snapshot and staged full2 RTL remain unexecuted. Physical inputs are preparation only. Resource admission, full special-resource semantics, physical timing, platform integration, DDR/HBM board bandwidth, power and end-to-end measurements remain outstanding.

requirements.requirement: Same-board DDR/HBM memory-backend measurements with actual platform/clock
requirements.remaining: Latest local XRT observation finds zero devices; actual platform, allocation, calibrated DDR/HBM and power measurements absent.

requirements.requirement: Full placement/routing comparison, legality/success/iterations/quality and end-to-end accounting
requirements.remaining: 21 workers complete captured-TSV to two-batch CPU chain; Vivado acquisition, training, transfer, physical readback and board runtime remain outside that timer.

requirements.requirement: One entrypoint, immutable manifests, hashes, versions, commands, regressions and research report
requirements.remaining: New active artifacts not yet durably archived; final experiment commands, complete matrix and final research report remain.
